vb_textbox.text: be as fast as you can, stay consistent and make sure you don't miss any as you need as many points as possible! the first half i stuck with the gnomes that had brown and grey hats, then when the points started dropping i kept choosing all other gnomes other than brown and grey and then switched back to brown and grey if the points dropped again, if your getting 5+ points then your doing good, if not then try pick different gnomes and find a pattern, my advice about the colours worked out for me so give that a try!
